scope: Actual registered scene-reference alias resolver used by dynamic path points.

mappings.qualification: The portable world is a projection of already loaded native alias groups and scene records. The loader must preserve signed counts, group order, valid member backing and reference identities; decoding/lifetime of the native variable-stride allocation remains a host boundary. Nonnegative valid backing addresses, finite transforms in composed refresh cases. Native invalid pointers, pathological overlapping records and malformed strides are excluded. Null reference is explicitly supported by the validity/resolution entrypoints; identity comparison requires two valid reference records. The current-world provider stands for the independently recovered55f450 global getter. It is not a scene-name lookup or an invented fallback callback. No new authored script-use credit.48 refresh compositions are included in2,229, not additive. Prior refresh2,766 and angle32,041 suites are not counted again. The C# replay compiled; managed execution remains pending. Native comparisons use an independent model against original x86.
mappings.comparisonStatus: Original-PC comparisons passed; portable replay compile only.
